title: ScamBuster STIX extension — x_scambuster_ttp_sighting
description: Per-cluster attribution attached to a STIX 2.1 sighting of a TTP attack-pattern (schema version 1.0). Carries the ScamBuster threat-actor cluster id so that sightings of the same attack-pattern by different clusters stay distinguishable in the shared TAXII feed (a sighting cannot carry the cluster in sighting_of_ref or where_sighted_refs).
